description: Shared cofold worker/launcher CLI contract. Every container's tests/test_cli_contract.py reads this file and fails when a flag marked 'supported' or 'rejected' is missing from the installed argparse parser or advertises a different domain. Status values are exactly supported, rejected and unknown: 'supported' means every value in the domain is accepted; 'rejected' means the flag is not accepted at all, or only the values in container_domain are accepted; 'unknown' means no per-container decision has been made.

output_format_decision.decision: The worker accepts mmcif only; cif was removed.
output_format_decision.reason: run_cofold.py allows mmcif|pdb, so --output-format cif at the ESMFold2 worker was unreachable through the launcher while duplicating mmcif byte for byte. Every value each container accepts is now reachable through the shared launcher: mmcif and pdb for Boltz2, mmcif for ESMFold2 and Chai-1, with pdb rejected by name because those engines write mmCIF only; Protenix likewise writes mmCIF only.

reason.esmfold2: ESMFold2 folds one trajectory per native call; a value above 1 is refused by the parser before inference.
reason.chai1: Chai-1 folds one sample per native call; a value above 1 is refused by the parser before inference.
reason.protenix: Protenix folds one diffusion sample per native call in this container, so a value above 1 is refused by the parser before inference.

reason.chai1: chai_lab 0.6.1 exposes no fused/reference kernel switch; the flag has no Chai-1 equivalent.
reason.protenix: The released protenix-v2 checkpoint runs its configured triangle kernels (cuequivariance) unconditionally; there is no fused/reference switch to turn off.

reason.esmfold2: No ESMFold2 equivalent; the capability is not part of that engine.
reason.chai1: No Chai-1 equivalent; the capability is not part of that engine.
reason.protenix: No Protenix equivalent; the capability is not part of this engine.

reason.chai1: chai_lab 0.6.1 exposes no selectable kernel backend; the flag is not accepted.
reason.protenix: protenix 2.0.0 exposes no selectable kernel backend at the worker CLI; triangle attention/multiplicative kernels are configuration, not a runtime backend switch.

reason.esmfold2: ESMFold2 writes mmCIF only; pdb is refused with an explicit message. cif is not a shared value and was removed from the worker.
reason.chai1: Chai-1 writes mmCIF only; pdb is refused with an explicit message.
reason.protenix: Protenix writes mmCIF only; pdb is refused with an explicit message.

reason.esmfold2: The ESMFold2 container writes capture/ unconditionally and has no opt-out flag (container-development.md section 16); --capture is not accepted.
reason.chai1: The Chai-1 container writes its native arrays unconditionally and has no opt-out flag; --capture is not accepted.
reason.protenix: The Protenix container writes its native PAE/PDE/atom-pLDDT arrays unconditionally and has no opt-out flag; --capture is not accepted.

reason.boltz2: Default 'tensors' scores the written PAE with the shared ipSAE module and writes metrics/derived.json before capture may be dropped; works with --capture none.
reason.esmfold2: Default 'tensors' scores each written sample's PAE against its token map and writes metrics/derived.json; capture/ is unaffected.
reason.chai1: Default 'tensors' scores each written sample's PAE against its token map and writes metrics/derived.json; capture/ is unaffected.
reason.protenix: Default 'tensors' scores each written sample's token_pair_pae against its Protenix token map and writes metrics/derived.json; the native arrays are written either way.
